constitution.title: Claude’s Constitution
constitution.significance: Anthropic describes the values and behavior it aims to develop in Claude.
constitution.connection: This document states the behaviors Anthropic wanted post-training to encourage. The evaluations later in the report test how Claude actually responded.

hle.title: Humanity’s Last Exam
hle.significance: This evaluation assembles difficult expert-written questions across a range of subjects.
hle.connection: Anthropic used questions from this benchmark to compare answers with different tools available. The allowed tools are part of the test conditions.

wandr.title: WANDR: Wide and Deep Research
wandr.significance: WANDR tests whether a research agent can gather information across many distinct entities as well as track down details about them.
wandr.connection: The report uses WANDR to test whether an agent can find information for a whole collection. A single successful search covers only one item in that test.

opus.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
opus.significance: The earlier system card records a comparison model’s performance on MILU, a multilingual evaluation.
opus.connection: Anthropic uses a score reported in this earlier study for comparison. To judge performance in a particular language, check that the two tests used comparable conditions.

occurrences.excerpt: After pretraining, the model underwent substantial post-training and fine-tuning to make it an assistant whose behavior aligns with the values described in Claude’s constitution.
occurrences.rationale: This document states the behaviors Anthropic wanted post-training to encourage. The evaluations later in the report test how Claude actually responded.

occurrences.excerpt: Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) is a multimodal benchmark of 2,500 questions spanning dozens of subjects.
occurrences.rationale: Anthropic used questions from this benchmark to compare answers with different tools available. The allowed tools are part of the test conditions.

occurrences.excerpt: WANDR (Wide ANd Deep Research) is a benchmark from Perplexity intended as a wide-search counterpart to the DRACO deep research benchmark.
occurrences.rationale: The report uses WANDR to test whether an agent can find information for a whole collection. A single successful search covers only one item in that test.
